quotes.text: A serendipitous great timeWe did not expect to be able to find and take a bout tour at Peggy's Cove, but we kind of walked right into this one. Had a great time on this one hour boat ride. The Captain stops the boat in front of the Lighthouse and the first mate takes pictures of all on board...got a great picture. Also, kids on board get to drive the boat for a short while. Relaxing ride, great scenery, and accommodating crew, all for a reasonable price!

Warm reception and friendly crewThe crew and Peter the captain were fantastic with my 90yr old grandmother. We had a lovely day and saw several puffins and gray seals. Highly recommended as it is close to Halifax and the tours take place on a boat that is easy to maneuver in to get the best views of the wildlife. Also, the view of Peggy's Cove lighthouse on the way is not to be missed.

What a fun hour and half!!!!The captain and first mate were so nice, pretty sure the 1st mate was speaking Gaelic to people in the cove!!! The coves were beautiful and the rock formations left you in awe. The Captain let us navigate the vessel and they took pictures of us in front of the light house, so good people thought they were photoshopped.Go and have fun!!!!!
Great Time FishingThis was a highlight of our trip. We had a great time and caught lots of mackerel, as well as some pollack and cod. Staff. We're very friendly.
